issues.detail: The Hebrew name צִפֹּרָה (Zipporah) is rendered as 西比拉 (Sibylla), which is a different name. The correct transliteration should be 西坡拉 or similar.
The Hebrew צֹר (flint) is rendered as 推羅 (Tyre), which is a place name, not the object used. The correct rendering should be 火石 or 石刀.
The Hebrew לְרַגְלָיו (to his feet) is rendered as 他的腳掌 (the sole of his foot), which narrows the meaning. The Hebrew refers to the feet generally, not specifically the sole.
